Unfortunately, my experience with this GP practice has been consistently frustrating and deeply disappointing. There have been multiple serious administrative errors that have undermined my confidence in their ability to provide safe and effective care.

On several occasions, my husband and I have been given incorrect information regarding blood test results—either the results are miscommunicated when I call, or I’m not contacted at all about important findings that clearly warrant follow-up. Despite sending emails and receiving confirmation of delivery, I’m frequently told they haven’t been received, which delays care unnecessarily.

Appointments have been cancelled without any notification, meaning I only find out after waiting and wasting time and this causes significant inconvenience.

When seeking advice, I am often given conflicting or inaccurate information, and the reception staff, while possibly overwhelmed, are unhelpful and dismissive more often than not. It’s disheartening that almost every interaction with this surgery results in a negative experience, whether it’s a lack of follow-through, poor communication, or a general disregard for patient concerns.

I sincerely hope the management takes steps to address these ongoing issues, as the current standard of service is unacceptable and potentially
